entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say a few words about why you're calling.
I need to return some shoes.
Connecting you to an agent now.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, and I'm with VeloFit Customer Support. I see you're calling about a return. I can help with that. Could I get your name and order number, please?
Hi Isaac, it's Maria Flores. The order number is VF88602.

Thank you, Maria. I have your order right here for the Pro-Lace Cycling Shoes. To get started, could you tell me a bit more about the issue? Is it a technical fault with the shoe, or more of a preference issue?

It's just... they're not working for me. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I was so excited for these new cycling shoes. But no matter how I position the cleats, they just give me awful blisters on my heels. I can't even ride for ten minutes.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that, Maria. Getting blisters is the last thing you want when you're trying to enjoy a ride. Let me see what we can do to get this sorted out for you.
I really hope so. I just feel so let down. And honestly, with things being tight, I was really counting on getting that money back. I just want a simple refund.

I completely understand. Let's take care of this right now. I'm checking your order date, and I see you received them 35 days ago. Our policy for standard items like these shoes is a 90-day return window, so you are well within the timeframe. I can absolutely process that full refund for you.
Oh, really? That's... that's a huge relief. Thank you.

Of course. And Maria, I see here that you're one of our VIP members. We truly value your loyalty, and I'm genuinely sorry these shoes caused you so much discomfort. For the trouble, I've gone ahead and waived the return shipping fee, and I've also added a $15 credit to your account for your next purchase with us.
Wow, you didn't have to do that. That's really kind. Thank you so much, Isaac. That makes me feel a lot better.

It's my pleasure. You should be receiving an email with the pre-paid return label in the next few minutes. Just pack the shoes in their original box, attach the label, and drop them off. Once we receive them, the refund will be issued to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help. Thanks again.
You're very welcome, Maria. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
